label: VB: build solution (MSBuild)
command: $sln = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT' -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.sln', '.slnx' }); if ($sln.Count -ne 1) { throw ('Expected exactly one .sln/.slnx in the worktree root, found ' + $sln.Count + '. Use a current-project task instead.') }; $sln = $sln[0].FullName; $msbuild = $env:VB_MSBUILD; if (-not $msbuild) { $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswhere) { $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -prerelease -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1 } }; if (-not $msbuild) { $msbuild = (Get-Command msbuild.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'MSBuild.exe not found. Install Visual Studio or Build Tools for Visual Studio (.NET desktop build tools), or set the VB_MSBUILD environment variable to the full path of MSBuild.exe.' }; & $msbuild $sln -nologo -m -v:minimal -restore -p:RestorePackagesConfig=true; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

label: VB: build current project (MSBuild)
command: $d = '$ZED_DIRNAME'; $proj = $null; while ($d -and -not $proj) { $proj = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -File -Filter *.vbproj -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $proj) { $d = Split-Path -Parent $d } }; if (-not $proj) { throw 'No .vbproj found in or above the current file''s folder.' }; $msbuild = $env:VB_MSBUILD; if (-not $msbuild) { $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswhere) { $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -prerelease -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1 } }; if (-not $msbuild) { $msbuild = (Get-Command msbuild.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'MSBuild.exe not found. Install Visual Studio or Build Tools for Visual Studio (.NET desktop build tools), or set the VB_MSBUILD environment variable to the full path of MSBuild.exe.' }; & $msbuild $proj.FullName -nologo -m -v:minimal -restore -p:RestorePackagesConfig=true; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

label: VB: build and run current project (MSBuild)
command: $d = '$ZED_DIRNAME'; $proj = $null; while ($d -and -not $proj) { $proj = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -File -Filter *.vbproj -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $proj) { $d = Split-Path -Parent $d } }; if (-not $proj) { throw 'No .vbproj found in or above the current file''s folder.' }; $msbuild = $env:VB_MSBUILD; if (-not $msbuild) { $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswhere) { $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -prerelease -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1 } }; if (-not $msbuild) { $msbuild = (Get-Command msbuild.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'MSBuild.exe not found. Install Visual Studio or Build Tools for Visual Studio (.NET desktop build tools), or set the VB_MSBUILD environment variable to the full path of MSBuild.exe.' }; & $msbuild $proj.FullName -nologo -m -v:minimal -restore -p:RestorePackagesConfig=true; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $xml = [xml](Get-Content -LiteralPath $proj.FullName); $asm = @($xml.Project.PropertyGroup | ForEach-Object { $_.AssemblyName } | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notmatch '\$\(' })[0]; if (-not $asm) { $asm = $proj.BaseName }; $exe = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $proj.DirectoryName 'bin') -Recurse -File -Filter ($asm + '.exe') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $exe) { throw ('Build succeeded but ' + $asm + '.exe was not found under ' + (Join-Path $proj.DirectoryName 'bin')) }; Set-Location -LiteralPath $exe.DirectoryName; & $exe.FullName

label: VB: dotnet run current project
command: $d = '$ZED_DIRNAME'; $proj = $null; while ($d -and -not $proj) { $proj = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -File -Filter *.vbproj -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $proj) { $d = Split-Path -Parent $d } }; if (-not $proj) { throw 'No .vbproj found in or above the current file''s folder.' }; & dotnet run --project $proj.FullName
